    Centered Boca extension perimeter #

    This is the precise constructive endpoint needed for free-product lifting. The chosen coordinate gives a state on every finite-dimensional factor. On reduced words whose letters lie in that state's kernel, the extension has Boca's product formula. Unlike the weaker generator-only BocaUCPExtension, this formula carries the finite-word estimates used by permanence.
